Clear wide rideable exit ramp leads away from overlook toward safe learning corridor and one three-way fork visible at edge; LEFT A forest path, CENTER B service path, RIGHT C padlocked violet tunnel sign. Use continuous scooter ramps, no steps or stairs anywhere on travel lane. Lower 35 percent separated FRONT/SIDE/TOP props: terrain edge/wedge, 4m wooden fence module, route sign post, simple bottle, low-poly rock, spruce, skyline card plane. All three routes visibly meet same lower overlook. No steps or stairs anywhere player rides, simple low faceted banks and ramps instead. Lower 30 percent: same three lanes as small flat top-down blockout thumbnails, plus terrain slope cross-section and small legend showing neutral ground vs collision banks. No directional arrows so contradictory arrow direction cannot occur. No extra forks, decorative route loops or disconnected platforms. No accurate real-world geography, no entire city beyond small skyline cards, no volumetric fog obscuring paths, no UI, no watermark. Modeling reference with clear shared start/fork/merge.
